title: vesper 空心记录文件清单
domain: 物业、房地产与社区管理人员
role: 物业、房地产与社区管理人员
instruction:
您将接管 Stonebridge Solutions 的 Vesper Hollow Ranch 文件。该房产从1974到1998分六个附属阶段建造，我们继承的只是一份未经修改的原始声明复印件。马洛钱伯斯 (Marlowe Chambers) 的伊沃·库里 (Ivo Khouri) 无法就计划中的倒退执行提供建议，除非我们能够解释这两个县和所使用的三个开发商名称的每一份记录的管理文书、兼并和地区地图。准备`recorded_governing_document_inventory.xlsx`作为受控工作清单、研究路线图、时间表和预算，我们可以在记录工作开始之前授权。伊沃（Ivo）了解标题工作；将维护该文件的 Wilhelmina Kristiansen 不会这样做，但这不能成为标题研究教程。在这项工作进行到一半时，Stonebridge Solutions 也将从其共享驱动器跟踪器转移到物质系统，因此工作簿必须在过渡期间保持可用，并在之后干净地迁移。包括基本预测和可辩护的高成本案例，但不要将假设的记录细节作为调查结果提供或提供法律意见。整个工作簿的打印页数不要超过六页。使用该文件名将完成的文件放置在工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `recorded_governing_document_inventory.xlsx` — 六阶段财产的受控记录管理文件清单、研究路线图、时间表和情景预算。 （该工作簿必须可供没有标题研究经验的律师和协调员使用，支持共享驱动器过渡期和后来的物质系统迁移，区分假设与经过验证的记录事实，包括基本和高成本预测，并且总共不超过六页印刷页。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

criteria.description: 所需的 XLSX 存在于指定的顶级路径中，打开时不会出现修复警告，并且包含可读的工作簿内容。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件及其工作簿结构。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用电子表格应用程序打开确切的文件名，并确认工作表、公式和显示的值正常加载。

original.criterion: The required XLSX exists at the specified top-level path, opens without repair warnings and contains readable workbook content.
original.evidence: The submitted file and its workbook structure.
original.grader_hint: Open the exact filename with a spreadsheet application and confirm that sheets, formulas and displayed values load normally.

criteria.description: 完整的工作簿配置为总共不超过六个打印页进行渲染。
criteria.evidence: 定义的打印区域、页面设置和打印预览页数。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染或检查每张可打印工作表的打印预览并对页面进行求和。排除真正空白的实用工作表，但不排除打印区域之外的实质性内容。

original.criterion: The complete workbook is configured to render in no more than six printed pages in total.
original.evidence: Defined print areas, page setup and print-preview page count.
original.grader_hint: Render or inspect print preview for every printable sheet and sum the pages. Exclude genuinely blank utility sheets, but not substantive content left outside a print area.

criteria.description: 该工作手册明确阐述了其操作目的：在律师评估挫折问题之前授权和控制所需的记录汇编。
criteria.evidence: 目的陈述、决策门或类似的介绍性内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 审阅者应该能够确定工作簿支持哪些决定以及为什么要进行记录工作。

original.criterion: The workbook clearly frames its operational purpose: authorizing and controlling the records compilation needed before counsel evaluates the setback issue.
original.evidence: Purpose statement, decision gate or comparable introductory content.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to identify what decision the workbook supports and why the records work is being undertaken.

criteria.description: 该范围明确说明了所有六个附加阶段，并且不会默默地将原始阶段视为涵盖后续阶段。
criteria.evidence: 相位寄存器、覆盖矩阵或等效控件。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算不同的阶段级范围记录或控制，并确认有六个，每个都独立地能够承载覆盖状态。

original.criterion: The scope explicitly accounts for all six annexed phases and does not silently treat the original phase as covering later phases.
original.evidence: Phase register, coverage matrix or equivalent controls.
original.grader_hint: Count distinct phase-level scope records or controls and confirm there are six, with each independently capable of carrying a coverage status.

criteria.description: 内容对于经验丰富的标题审阅者来说足够简洁，同时对于没有标题研究经验的协调员来说仍然可以执行。
criteria.evidence: 术语、提示、状态指导和总体信息密度。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断协调员是否可以在不询问每个控制含义的情况下维护工作簿，而律师也不会被迫通过基本教程。

original.criterion: The content is concise enough for an experienced title reviewer while remaining executable by a coordinator without title-research experience.
original.evidence: Terminology, prompts, status guidance and overall information density.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the coordinator can maintain the workbook without asking what each control means, while counsel is not forced through a basic tutorial.

criteria.description: 该工作簿将记录的事实、研究假设、未解决的问题和建议的决定分为不同类型的信息。
criteria.evidence: 标签、字段、图例和未解决问题的处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认用户不能合理地将计划假设或工作人员解释误认为是经过验证的记录事实或法律结论。

original.criterion: The workbook separates recorded facts, research assumptions, unresolved questions and counsel determinations as distinct kinds of information.
original.evidence: Labels, fields, legends and treatment of unresolved issues.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that a user cannot reasonably mistake a planning assumption or staff interpretation for a verified recording fact or legal conclusion.

criteria.description: 潜在的法律效力决定明确保留给律师，而不是分配给记录研究人员。
criteria.evidence: 角色语言接近问题、冲突或处置控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求语言保留约束力、优先权、可执行性或对律师的解释；不需要确切的短语。

original.criterion: Potential legal-effect determinations are expressly reserved for counsel rather than assigned to records-research staff.
original.evidence: Role language near issue, conflict or disposition controls.
original.grader_hint: Look for language reserving binding effect, priority, enforceability or interpretation to counsel; an exact phrase is not required.

criteria.description: 每个阶段都可以根据声明、吞并文书和适用的地图或平台进行协调，而不是仅接收一个通用的完整/不完整标志。
criteria.evidence: 逐个文档类别的覆盖范围控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证是否可以针对每个阶段单独评估三个核心证据类别。

original.criterion: Each phase can be reconciled against the declaration, annexation instrument and applicable map or plat rather than receiving only a single generic complete/incomplete flag.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the three core evidence categories can be assessed separately for every phase.

criteria.description: 每个阶段都支持明确的研究状态，区分未搜索、进行中、已识别差距和已完成或等效状态。
criteria.evidence: 阶段状态控制及其定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果等效的受控词汇阻止空白单元格被解释为完整，则接受等效的受控词汇。

original.criterion: Every phase supports an explicit research status that distinguishes unsearched, in progress, gap identified and completed or equivalent states.
original.evidence: Phase status controls and their definitions.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent controlled vocabulary if it prevents a blank cell from being interpreted as complete.

criteria.description: 阶段控制保留了原始声明和后来的附件之间的关系，而不假设仅按时间顺序来证明覆盖范围。
criteria.evidence: 父工具、吞并链接或依赖字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一种明确的方法来记录据称添加每个阶段的仪器以及它如何链接回早期仪器。

original.criterion: The phase controls preserve the relationship between the original declaration and later annexations without assuming that a chronological sequence alone proves coverage.
original.evidence: Parent instrument, annexation linkage or dependency fields.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit way to record which instrument purportedly adds each phase and how it links back to earlier instruments.

criteria.description: 工作簿可以记录阶段别名、区域标识符或法律描述线索，用于识别不同索引记录中的阶段。
criteria.evidence: 阶段识别字段或搜索控件。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认相位匹配不限于一个非正式的相位名称。

original.criterion: The workbook can record phase aliases, tract identifiers or legal-description cues used to recognize a phase across differently indexed records.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that phase matching is not limited to one informal phase name.

criteria.description: 在阶段或仪器级别跟踪县管辖权，以便不会忽视相交叉或记录仪管辖权的变化。
criteria.evidence: 县域和相位/仪器关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证县是受控属性，而不仅仅是隐藏在自由格式的注释中。

original.criterion: County jurisdiction is tracked at the phase or instrument level so that a phase crossing or changing recorder jurisdiction cannot be overlooked.
original.grader_hint: Verify that county is a controlled attribute, not merely buried in free-form notes.

criteria.description: 搜索计划提供了所有三个已知的开发者实体名称，并保留在研究过程中发现的其他名称变体。
criteria.evidence: 名称变体寄存器或搜索计划控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认三个初始开发者名称以及新发现的变体的容量和明确的计划覆盖范围；不需要实际发明的名称。

original.criterion: The search plan provides for all three known developer entity names and preserves additional name variants discovered during research.
original.grader_hint: Confirm capacity and explicit planned coverage for three initial developer names plus newly found variants; actual invented names are not required.

criteria.description: 仅仅因为找到了一个响应仪器，就不能将一个阶段标记为完成；完成需要协调已定义的阶段证据类别和开放差距。
criteria.evidence: 完成定义、公式或批准门。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查完成逻辑或指令，并确保未解决的核心文档差距阻碍完成。

original.criterion: A phase cannot be marked complete merely because one responsive instrument was found; completion requires reconciliation of the defined phase evidence categories and open gaps.
original.evidence: Completion definition, formula or approval gate.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the completion logic or instructions and ensure that unresolved core-document gaps block completion.

criteria.description: 文书分类包括原始声明或契约作为独特的记录文件类别。
criteria.evidence: 文档类型词汇表或清单字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受实质上等效的术语。

original.criterion: The instrument taxonomy includes original declarations or covenants as a distinct recorded-document category.
original.grader_hint: Accept substantively equivalent terminology.

criteria.description: 文书分类包括修订并允许它们与修订后的文书相关联。
criteria.evidence: 文档类型和交叉引用控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认受影响仪器的类别和可用关系。

original.criterion: The instrument taxonomy includes amendments and permits them to be linked to the instrument amended.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the category and a usable relationship to the affected instrument.

criteria.description: 附件、补充声明或类似的阶段添加文书是一个独特的可检索和可报告类别。
criteria.evidence: 记录分类和阶段覆盖控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 工作手册必须使阶段添加工具可见，而不是将所有内容分组到修正案中。

original.criterion: Annexation, supplemental declaration or comparable phase-adding instruments are a distinct searchable and reportable category.
original.evidence: Document taxonomy and phase coverage controls.
original.grader_hint: The workbook must make phase-adding instruments visible rather than grouping everything under amendments.

criteria.description: 记录的地图、地图或区域地图与文本管理工具分开跟踪。
criteria.evidence: 记录分类和库存控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认地图证据可以携带自己的参考、复制状态和相位关系。

original.criterion: Recorded maps, plats or tract maps are tracked separately from text governing instruments.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that map evidence can carry its own reference, copy status and phase relationship.

criteria.description: 分类法可以将重述或替代文书与普通修正案区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 文档类型、关系字段或处置控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一种方法来记录旨在取代、重述或替换早期文本的文书。

original.criterion: The taxonomy can distinguish a restatement or replacement instrument from an ordinary amendment.
original.evidence: Document types, relationship fields or disposition controls.
original.grader_hint: Look for a way to record that an instrument purports to supersede, restate or replace earlier text.

criteria.description: 研究范围将记录的任务、开发人员名称变更或后继工具视为链条中可能的环节。
criteria.evidence: 搜索类别、名称历史或关系字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认可以记录实体继承并用于继续搜索。

original.criterion: The research scope recognizes recorded assignments, developer name changes or successor instruments as possible links in the chain.
original.evidence: Search categories, name history or relationship fields.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that entity succession can be recorded and used to continue searching.

criteria.description: 该工作手册将记录的治理文书与未记录的协会政策、决议和运营记录区分开来，但并不意味着后者可以弥补记录差距。
criteria.evidence: 范围注释、文档类别或异常处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种区别应防止不相关的内部记录被计为记录相覆盖的证据。

original.criterion: The workbook distinguishes recorded governing instruments from unrecorded association policies, resolutions and operating records without implying that the latter can cure a recording gap.
original.evidence: Scope notes, document categories or exception handling.
original.grader_hint: The distinction should prevent unrelated internal records from being counted as proof of recorded phase coverage.

criteria.description: 核心管理文件范围之外的潜在相关地役权、契约或其他记录文书具有提交或发布路径，而不是被默默地计算或丢弃。
criteria.evidence: 异常类别、转介状态或问题控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一种方法来保留潜在相关的超出范围的调查结果以供律师审查。

original.criterion: Potentially relevant easements, deeds or other recorded instruments outside the core governing-document scope have a referral or issue path rather than being silently counted or discarded.
original.evidence: Exception category, referral status or issue control.
original.grader_hint: Look for a way to preserve potentially relevant out-of-scope findings for counsel review.

criteria.description: 每个经过验证的仪器记录都可以捕获记录器分配的仪器编号、接收编号或书籍和页面引用。
criteria.evidence: 库存元数据字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受单独的字段或一个明确定义的引用字段，以适应两种索引约定。

original.criterion: Each verified instrument record can capture the recorder-assigned instrument number, reception number, or book-and-page citation.
original.grader_hint: Accept separate fields or one clearly defined citation field that accommodates both indexing conventions.

criteria.description: 记录日期的捕获独立于其他日期。
criteria.evidence: 库存元数据字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该字段具体是记录的日期。

original.criterion: Recording date is captured independently of other dates.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the field is specifically the date recorded.

criteria.description: 执行、采用或生效日期可以与记录日期分开记录。
criteria.evidence: 库存元数据字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 单个不明确的日期字段不能同时满足此项和记录日期项。

original.criterion: Execution, adoption or effective date can be captured separately from recording date.
original.grader_hint: A single ambiguous date field does not satisfy both this item and the recording-date item.

criteria.description: 每个仪器记录都标识记录县或记录者管辖范围。
criteria.evidence: 库存元数据字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 首选适合过滤或迁移的受控场。

original.criterion: Each instrument record identifies the recording county or recorder jurisdiction.
original.grader_hint: Prefer a controlled field suitable for filtering or migration.

criteria.description: 索引方名称可以如记录器所示进行记录，包括授予者和受让人或等效索引方。
criteria.evidence: 参与方名称元数据或链接的参与方记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认工作簿不会将所有索引方缩减为一个非机密名称。

original.criterion: Indexed party names can be recorded as shown by the recorder, including grantor and grantee or equivalent index sides.
original.evidence: Party-name metadata or linked party records.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the workbook does not reduce all indexed parties to one unclassified name.

criteria.description: 可以捕获记录的标题或乐器描述，而无需将其替换为五线谱速记。
criteria.evidence: 仪器标题元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 单独的短标签是可以接受的，但记录器/文档标题必须有一席之地。

original.criterion: The recorded title or instrument description can be captured without replacing it with staff shorthand.
original.grader_hint: A separate short label is acceptable, but the recorder/document title must have a place.

criteria.description: 库存可以保留测试阶段覆盖所需的法律描述参考或区域、地块、地块和地图线索。
criteria.evidence: 法律描述或财产参考字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 工作簿不需要复制完整的法律描述，但必须保留可用的标识符以及完整描述的显示位置。

original.criterion: The inventory can retain the legal-description reference or tract, lot, parcel and map cues needed to test phase coverage.
original.grader_hint: The workbook need not reproduce a full legal description, but it must preserve usable identifiers and where the full description appears.

criteria.description: 一台仪器可以链接到一个、多个或所有阶段，而不是强制进入一个阶段。
criteria.evidence: 仪器与相位关系设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查多对多关系是否可以表示，而无需重复和分散仪器记录。

original.criterion: An instrument can be linked to one, several or all phases rather than being forced into exactly one phase.
original.grader_hint: Inspect whether a many-to-many relationship is representable without duplicating and diverging the instrument record.

criteria.description: 可以捕获并跟踪记录的对先前或后来仪器的参考。
criteria.evidence: 交叉引用、前任、后继或相关仪器控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认用户可以记录引用的参考文献以及它是否已被检索。

original.criterion: Recorded references to prior or later instruments can be captured and followed.
original.evidence: Cross-reference, predecessor, successor or related-instrument controls.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that users can record both the cited reference and whether it has been retrieved.

criteria.description: 每个发现都可以保留可重复的源定位器以及访问或获取的日期。
criteria.evidence: 来源和访问元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 单独的通用县名并不是可重复的定位符；期望索引 URL/路径、请求引用、搜索结果引用或同等内容。

original.criterion: Each finding can retain a reproducible source locator and the date it was accessed or obtained.
original.grader_hint: A generic county name alone is not a reproducible locator; expect index URL/path, request reference, search result citation or equivalent.

criteria.description: 复制状态将索引命中与所获取的文档图像或物理副本区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 复制状态词汇和定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证指数结果不会被误认为是基础工具的持有和审查。

original.criterion: Copy status distinguishes an index hit from an obtained document image or physical copy.
original.grader_hint: Verify that an index result cannot be mistaken for possession and review of the underlying instrument.

criteria.description: 认证状态或对认证副本的需求可以与普通副本状态分开记录。
criteria.evidence: 认证字段或状态控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找要求的、收到的、不需要的或类似的区别。

original.criterion: Certification status or the need for a certified copy can be recorded separately from ordinary copy status.
original.grader_hint: Look for requested, received, not required or comparable distinctions.

criteria.description: 图像质量、缺页、难以辨认或 OCR 限制具有明确的异常状态。
criteria.evidence: 质量审查控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认收到文件并不自动意味着它是可审查和完整的。

original.criterion: Image quality, missing pages, illegibility or OCR limitations have an explicit exception status.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that receiving a file does not automatically mean it is reviewable and complete.

criteria.description: 每个经过审核的工具都可以与审核者和审核日期相关联。
criteria.evidence: 查看元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果工作簿保留明确的所有者图例，则可以接受缩写。

original.criterion: Each reviewed instrument can be tied to a reviewer and review date.
original.grader_hint: Initials are acceptable if the workbook maintains an unambiguous owner legend.

criteria.description: 研究路线图要求在每个已知的开发人员名称下进行搜索，而不是依赖于一个当前或熟悉的名称。
criteria.evidence: 搜索计划和名称变体控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认可以针对每个已知的开发者实体名称单独演示搜索覆盖范围。

original.criterion: The research roadmap requires searches under each known developer name rather than relying on one current or familiar name.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that search coverage can be demonstrated separately for every known developer entity name.

criteria.description: 关联名称的变体、缩写和合理的历史命名形式可以添加到搜索范围中。
criteria.evidence: 搜索名称注册或查询控件。
criteria.grader_hint: 该机制应保留搜索到的确切术语及其与属性的关系。

original.criterion: Association-name variants, abbreviations and plausible historical naming forms can be added to the search universe.
original.grader_hint: The mechanism should preserve the exact term searched and its relationship to the property.

criteria.description: 参与方名称搜索涵盖记录器索引的两侧或其本地等效项。
criteria.evidence: 搜索计划或搜索日志要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的授予者/受让人、直接/间接或等效的双向索引覆盖范围。

original.criterion: Party-name searching covers both sides of the recorder index or their local equivalents.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit grantor/grantee, direct/indirect, or equivalent bidirectional index coverage.

criteria.description: 该路线图包括在名称搜索不足时通过区域、地图、地块或法律描述线索进行基于财产的搜索。
criteria.evidence: 搜索方法和阶段标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该计划具有能够查找索引错误或名称不同的仪器的非名称路径。

original.criterion: The roadmap includes property-based searching by tract, map, parcel or legal-description cues when name searches are insufficient.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the plan has a non-name route capable of finding misindexed or differently named instruments.

criteria.description: 地图和平台索引研究被视为不同的搜索路径，与一般记录器索引分开。
criteria.evidence: 搜索路线图和日志类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划不应假定仅通过授予者-受让人搜索就能检索到区域地图。

original.criterion: Map and plat index research is treated as a distinct search path where it is separate from the general recorder index.
original.grader_hint: The plan should not assume that a grantor-grantee search alone will retrieve tract maps.

criteria.description: 该路线图需要在两个方向的仪器内部找到以下参考（如果适用）。
criteria.evidence: 交叉参考后续要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找涵盖引用的前人、修订、补充或后来的记录者参考文献的控制，而不仅仅是引文的转录。

original.criterion: The roadmap requires following references found inside instruments in both directions as applicable.
original.grader_hint: Look for a control covering cited predecessors, amendments, supplements or later recorder references, not merely transcription of citations.

criteria.description: 搜索日期范围是围绕阶段年表规划的，同时允许找到早期的基础记录和后来的修订。
criteria.evidence: 搜索假设、日期范围控制或路线图注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 该方法不应严格限制每个阶段的吞并年份或停止于1998 建设日期。

original.criterion: Search date ranges are planned around phase chronology while allowing earlier foundational records and later amendments to be found.
original.evidence: Search assumptions, date-range controls or roadmap notes.
original.grader_hint: The approach should not rigidly limit every phase to its annexation year or stop at the 1998 buildout date.

criteria.description: 搜索日志捕获管辖权或系统、搜索日期、搜索者、精确查询或索引词、日期范围和结果处置。
criteria.evidence: 搜索日志字段和定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有列出的元素必须能够代表每个搜索事件；通用的叙述性注释是不够的。

original.criterion: The search log captures jurisdiction or system, search date, searcher, exact query or index term, date range and result disposition.
original.grader_hint: All listed elements must be representable for each search event; generic narrative notes are insufficient.

criteria.description: 无结果的搜索可以以其查询和范围记录为肯定证据，而不是作为空白消失。
criteria.evidence: 搜索结果状态和日志设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认零结果可与未执行的搜索区分开。

original.criterion: A no-result search can be recorded as affirmative evidence with its query and scope rather than disappearing as a blank.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that zero results are distinguishable from searches not performed.

criteria.description: 当电子或名称索引搜索留下阶段间隙时，该路线图提供了可防御的升级或第二次通过路线。
criteria.evidence: 差距工作流程、备用来源或升级控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 期待实用的替代方案，例如手动索引审查、地图册、工作人员协助研究、现场检索或产权专业人员，而不需要所有这些。

original.criterion: The roadmap provides a defensible escalation or second-pass route when electronic or name-index searches leave a phase gap.
original.evidence: Gap workflow, alternate sources or escalation controls.
original.grader_hint: Expect practical alternatives such as manual index review, map books, staff-assisted research, on-site retrieval or a title professional, without requiring all of them.

criteria.description: 该工作手册针对包含不一致的挫折条款的工具有一个特定的发行机制。
criteria.evidence: 冲突或建议问题控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 单独的通用注释字段是不够的，除非它清楚地捕获了这两个条款、其来源和状态。

original.criterion: The workbook has a specific issue mechanism for instruments that contain inconsistent setback provisions.
original.grader_hint: A generic notes field alone is insufficient unless it clearly captures both provisions, their sources and their status.

criteria.description: 冲突文书仍然可见，因为竞争源记录有待律师审查，而不是合并到工作人员选定的一项规则中。
criteria.evidence: 冲突处理、问题状态和仪器记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断设计是否保留了矛盾，而不让研究人员默默宣布获胜者。

original.criterion: Conflicting instruments remain visible as competing source records pending counsel review rather than being merged into one staff-selected rule.
original.evidence: Conflict treatment, issue status and instrument records.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the design preserves the contradiction without allowing research staff to silently declare a winner.

criteria.description: 每个冲突的条款都可以与确切的仪器引文和页面、部分或图像位置相关联。
criteria.evidence: 问题详细信息和源位置字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认律师可以直接从冲突条目导航到两个源段落。

original.criterion: Each conflicting provision can be tied to an exact instrument citation and page, section or image location.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that counsel can navigate directly from the conflict entry to both source passages.

criteria.description: 冲突或歧义可以转化为具有所有者和处置状态的离散律师问题。
criteria.evidence: 咨询问题或问题工作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 该机制应区分悬而未决的问题和已解决的决定。

original.criterion: A conflict or ambiguity can be converted into a discrete counsel question with an owner and disposition status.
original.grader_hint: The mechanism should distinguish an open question from a resolved determination.

criteria.description: 被取代、重述或显然被取代的工具仍保留在历史清单中，并记录了它们的关系。
criteria.evidence: 仪器状态和关系控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该处置不需要删除较早的记录。

original.criterion: Superseded, restated or apparently replaced instruments remain in the historical inventory with their relationships recorded.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that disposition does not require deleting an earlier record.

criteria.description: 重复控制使用记录身份和管辖权，以及书籍和页面或等效后备，而不是单独的标题文本。
criteria.evidence: 唯一键规则、重复标志或工作簿验证。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查记录或实施的重复逻辑。具有不同录音标识符的相同标题的乐器必须保持不同。

original.criterion: Duplicate control uses recording identity and jurisdiction, with book-and-page or equivalent fallback, rather than title text alone.
original.evidence: Unique-key rule, duplicate flag or workbook validation.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the documented or implemented duplicate logic. Identically titled instruments with different recording identifiers must remain distinct.

criteria.description: 完成摘要与基础阶段、搜索、仪器和开放间隙记录相一致，而不是依赖于手动输入的总计。
criteria.evidence: 公式、链接摘要和源记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪显示其基础范围或结构化数据的完成计数或状态，并测试源更改是否会更新摘要。

original.criterion: The completion summary reconciles to the underlying phase, search, instrument and open-gap records rather than relying on manually typed totals.
original.evidence: Formulas, linked summaries and source records.
original.grader_hint: Trace displayed completion counts or statuses to their underlying ranges or structured data and test whether a source change would update the summary.

criteria.description: 每个未解决的差距都可以带有具体的下一步行动、所有者、目标日期和阻止原因或依赖性。
criteria.evidence: 间隙或动作控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有四个元素都必须能够代表每个间隙；一般项目业主是不够的。

original.criterion: Every unresolved gap can carry a concrete next action, owner, target date and blocking reason or dependency.
original.grader_hint: All four elements must be representable for each gap; a general project owner is not enough.

criteria.description: 状态词汇是定义好的并且可以相互理解的，特别是定位、获得、审查、验证和完成之间的区别。
criteria.evidence: 图例、定义或嵌入式指南。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效术语是可以接受的，但用户不能将指数命中视为经过审查的工具或阶段完成。

original.criterion: Status vocabulary is defined and mutually understandable, particularly the difference between located, obtained, reviewed, verified and complete.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent terms are acceptable, but users must not be able to treat an index hit as a reviewed instrument or phase completion.

criteria.description: 该工作簿保留了记录器索引数据、文档图像文本、工作人员注释和律师决定之间的出处差异。
criteria.evidence: 来源类型、证据级别或归因控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断陈述是否可以追溯到其证据来源，以及摘要是否明显区分来源和解释。

original.criterion: The workbook preserves provenance differences among recorder-index data, document-image text, staff notes and counsel determinations.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether statements can be traced to their evidentiary source and whether summaries visibly distinguish source from interpretation.

criteria.description: 操作设计明确支持当前共享驱动环境中的工作，并识别到未来物质系统的受控切换。
criteria.evidence: 转换控制、工作流程说明或迁移准备内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 这两个时期都必须在操作上得到解决；仅仅说“稍后迁移”是不够的。

original.criterion: The operating design explicitly supports work in the current shared-drive environment and identifies the controlled handoff into the future matter system.
original.evidence: Transition controls, workflow notes or migration readiness content.
original.grader_hint: Both periods must be operationally addressed; simply saying 'migrate later' is insufficient.

criteria.description: 记录使用稳定的标识符和一致的结构化值，适合以后导入，而不依赖于单元格颜色、合并标题或自由格式位置的含义。
criteria.evidence: 标识符字段、受控值和数据组织。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查实质性记录以获得稳定的 ID 和机器可用值。格式可以帮助读者，但不能成为地位或关系的唯一载体。

original.criterion: Records use stable identifiers and consistently structured values suitable for later import without relying on cell color, merged headings or free-form position for meaning.
original.evidence: Identifier fields, controlled values and data organization.
original.grader_hint: Inspect substantive records for stable IDs and machine-usable values. Formatting may aid readers but must not be the only carrier of status or relationships.

criteria.description: 带日期的变更日志记录了工作簿的重大变更、变更人以及变更内容。
criteria.evidence: 修订或更改控制内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认日志涵盖实质性添加、更正和状态更改，而不仅仅是文档版本号。

original.criterion: A dated change log records material workbook changes, the person making them and what changed.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the log covers substantive additions, corrections and status changes rather than only document version numbers.

criteria.description: 该预算提出了一项明确确定的基本预测和一项使用相同定义范围的可辩护的高成本预测。
criteria.evidence: 情景预算和假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证这两个预测是否涵盖了六阶段、两个县的研究范围，并且不是不相关的估计。

original.criterion: The budget presents one clearly identified base forecast and one defensible high-cost forecast using the same defined scope.
original.grader_hint: Verify that both forecasts cover the six-phase, two-county research scope and are not unrelated estimates.

criteria.description: 该预测将主要成本驱动因素分开，包括研究劳动力、记录员或访问费、文件副本、所需的认证以及专家或升级工作。
criteria.evidence: 预算行项目和成本类别。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等类别是可以接受的，但单一的一次性估算不能满足本项要求。

original.criterion: The forecast separates major cost drivers, including research labor, recorder or access fees, document copies, certification where needed and specialist or escalation effort.
original.evidence: Budget line items and cost categories.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent categories are acceptable, but a single lump-sum estimate does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 每个可变预算项目都会公开其数量、单位和比率，或明确说明为什么它是固定津贴。
criteria.evidence: 预算假设和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪每条线的数量-时间-速率逻辑或明确标记的固定估计。

original.criterion: Each variable budget line exposes its quantity, unit and rate or clearly states why it is a fixed allowance.
original.grader_hint: Trace each line to quantity-times-rate logic or an explicitly labeled fixed estimate.

criteria.description: 场景线总计和总体总计由公式驱动，在算术上等于其显示的组件，范围在 ±$1 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式和显示的预算值。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算工作簿并独立地对每个场景的可见组件求和。只允许将差异四舍五入到一美元。

original.criterion: Scenario line totals and overall totals are formula-driven and arithmetically equal to their displayed components within ±$1.
original.evidence: Workbook formulas and displayed budget values.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the workbook and independently sum the visible components for each scenario. Allow only rounding differences up to one dollar.

criteria.description: 预算允许按县、阶段或另一个与情景总和在 ±$1 范围内协调的运营工作包来理解成本。
criteria.evidence: 预算分配和小计。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受实际的工作包细分，并提供每个相关场景的小计总和在一美元以内。

original.criterion: The budget permits costs to be understood by county, phase or another operational work package that reconciles to the scenario total within ±$1.
original.grader_hint: Accept a practical work-package breakdown, provided its subtotals sum to each relevant scenario total within one dollar.

criteria.description: 意外事件或不确定性是根据规定的驱动因素或比率单独确定的，并且不会通过增加普通单位成本来隐藏。
criteria.evidence: 预算假设和应急计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认用户可以看到不确定性如何进入估算，并避免在线路费率和意外事件之间重复计算。

original.criterion: Contingency or uncertainty is separately identified, based on a stated driver or rate, and is not hidden by inflating ordinary unit costs.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that users can see how uncertainty enters the estimate and avoid double counting it between line rates and contingency.

criteria.description: 该工作手册确定了初始授权请求的数量和范围以及发布高成本升级工作的决策点。
criteria.evidence: 授权摘要、预算门或决策控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 审阅者应该知道现在可以开始什么以及何时需要额外批准，而工作簿不会发明外部批准阈值。

original.criterion: The workbook identifies the amount and scope being requested for initial authorization and a decision point for releasing high-cost escalation work.
original.evidence: Authorization summary, budget gate or decision controls.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should know what can start now and when additional approval is required, without the workbook inventing an external approval threshold.

criteria.description: 该计划对授权、索引研究、文件检索、审查、差距升级以及与负责的所有者和依赖者的咨询交接进行了排序。
criteria.evidence: 时间表或路线图。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认列出的工作阶段在操作上是有序的、具有所有者并公开依赖关系，而不是显示为未注明日期的清单。

original.criterion: The schedule sequences authorization, index research, document retrieval, review, gap escalation and counsel handoff with accountable owners and dependencies.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the listed work stages are operationally ordered, carry owners and expose dependencies rather than appearing as an undated checklist.

criteria.description: 总的来说，工作簿是一个可用的控制工具：律师可以识别覆盖范围和未解决的冲突，协调员可以执行下一步行动，管理层可以授权预测而无需要求作者解码。
criteria.evidence: 完整渲染的工作簿及其库存、路线图、时间表和预算内容之间的交互。
criteria.grader_hint: 作为每个目标读者从头到尾地审查工件。技术上存在但支离破碎、难以辨认或矛盾的内容不应获得全额评分。

original.criterion: As a whole, the workbook is a usable control instrument: counsel can identify coverage and unresolved conflicts, the coordinator can execute the next action, and management can authorize the forecast without asking the author to decode it.
original.evidence: The complete rendered workbook and interactions among its inventory, roadmap, schedule and budget content.
original.grader_hint: Review the artifact end to end as each intended reader. Technically present but fragmented, illegible or contradictory content should not receive full credit.

criteria.description: 该工作簿将发明的、假设的或说明性的文书编号、记录日期、当事人名称、法律描述或文件调查结果作为经过验证的财产记录。
criteria.evidence: 填充仪器记录、标签和来源归属。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当不支持的记录细节被表示为实际结果时才应用处罚。明确标记的空白字段、有关工作量的假设或明确标记的非记录示例不会触发它。

original.criterion: The workbook presents invented, assumed or illustrative instrument numbers, recording dates, party names, legal descriptions or document findings as verified property records.
original.evidence: Populated instrument records, labels and source attribution.
original.grader_hint: Apply the penalty only when unsupported recording details are represented as actual findings. Clearly marked blank fields, assumptions about workload, or unmistakably labeled non-record examples do not trigger it.

spec.professional_context: Stonebridge Solutions is preparing records research needed before Marlowe Chambers can advise on a setback enforcement matter involving a six-phase community. The workbook will control authorization, research, review, handoff and later system migration.
difficulty_sources: Designing a defensible completeness control for six annexed phases without any underlying record set
Separating recorded evidence, research assumptions, staff observations and legal determinations
Planning searches across two recorder jurisdictions and multiple historical entity names
Preserving contradictory setback provisions for counsel without resolving them
Serving expert and novice users within a six-page print limit
Maintaining operational continuity while moving from a shared-drive tracker to a matter system
Integrating dependent inventory, search, schedule, authorization and scenario-budget controls

authoring_plan.artifact_intent: Create a compact, professional workbook that can authorize and control a phase-by-phase recorded-document compilation without pretending that research has already occurred. It must integrate the working inventory, research evidence, open issues, execution schedule and scenario budget while remaining understandable to both a title specialist and a novice coordinator.
required_imperfections_and_tensions: The only inherited item is described as an unverified photocopy; it must not be treated as proof of complete recorded coverage.

There are six annexed phases, two recorder jurisdictions and three initially known developer identities, so the design must prevent completion from being inferred from a single phase, county or name search.
Two future instruments may contain inconsistent setback language; the workbook must preserve both sources and route the issue to counsel without selecting a controlling rule.
One user understands title research and another does not, requiring concise definitions and controlled prompts rather than tutorial prose.
Work begins in a shared-drive process but moves into a matter system during the project, requiring stable identifiers, structured values, transition ownership and a change history.
No instrument details are available. The gold must contain no purported verified recording numbers, dates, legal descriptions, parties or findings.
professional_rules_to_encode: A phase is complete only when its declaration lineage, phase-adding instrument, applicable map or plat, cross-references, search coverage and open gaps have been reconciled.
An index hit is evidence of a possible record, not evidence that the underlying document has been obtained, reviewed or verified.
Searches must cover all known and discovered entity-name variants, both sides of party indexes, property-based indexes, map or plat indexes and instrument cross-references.
No-result searches are retained with the query, jurisdiction, date range, searcher and date because they are part of the completeness record.
Chronological proximity is not enough to assign an instrument to a phase; legal-description, tract, map or express annexation linkage must be recordable.
Each instrument has one stable identity, while its relationship to phases and other instruments may be many-to-many.
Duplicate identification relies on recorder jurisdiction plus recorder-assigned identity, with an appropriate book-and-page fallback; document titles alone are not unique.
Earlier and apparently superseded instruments remain in the historical chain and are related to replacements rather than deleted.
Document provenance distinguishes index metadata, obtained images, transcription or staff notes, and counsel determinations.
Recorded-document research staff identify and document inconsistencies but do not determine legal priority, enforceability or binding effect.
Potentially relevant non-core instruments are preserved as referrals or issues rather than silently included in governing-document completion counts.
Quality review records missing pages, illegibility and other copy defects before an item can be considered reviewed.
Open gaps require an owner, next action, target date and dependency, and unresolved core gaps block phase completion.
Current-process records must use stable IDs and controlled values that can be mapped into the future system without relying on color or position for meaning.
Material changes are dated and attributed so the live inventory remains auditable during migration.
budget_and_schedule_derivation: Provide a base case and a high-cost case over the same six-phase and two-jurisdiction scope.
Use clearly labeled planning assumptions rather than external rates presented as facts.
For each variable budget line, total cost equals quantity multiplied by rate; fixed allowances must be identified as fixed.
Scenario totals equal the sum of their component line totals, and any operational allocation subtotals reconcile to the scenario total within one dollar.
Contingency is shown separately and calculated from an identified uncertainty driver or stated percentage, without duplicating uncertainty already loaded into unit rates.
The initial authorization amount covers a defined starting scope, while escalation work has a visible decision gate rather than being automatically included.
The schedule connects authorization, index work, retrieval, review, gap escalation and counsel handoff through explicit owners and dependencies.
controlled_concepts: Copy, certification, quality and review status
Gap action, owner, target date and dependency
gold_construction_notes: Construct the workbook offline using standard spreadsheet tooling and include formulas, validation or equivalent controls that make the relational rules testable.
Use compact labels and short embedded definitions so the novice user can operate the workbook without expanding it into a title-research course.
Keep assumptions about workload and rates visibly separate from any property-record fields.
Do not populate instrument rows with realistic-looking examples unless every such value is unmistakably labeled as non-record demonstration data; a clean blank controlled inventory is preferable.
Configure print areas and page setup, then render every substantive sheet and verify that the combined output is six pages or fewer.
Recalculate formulas and independently test phase counts, scenario totals, subtotals, completion gates and duplicate logic before finalizing the gold.

deliverables.description: A controlled recorded-governing-document inventory, research roadmap, schedule and scenario budget for the six-phase property.
constraints: The workbook must be usable by counsel and a coordinator without title-research experience, support both the shared-drive transition period and later matter-system migration, distinguish assumptions from verified recording facts, include base and high-cost forecasts, and render in no more than six printed pages total.

original_instruction:
You’re taking over the Vesper Hollow Ranch file for Stonebridge Solutions. The property was built in six annexed phases from 1974 through 1998, and all we inherited is a photocopied original declaration with no amendments. Ivo Khouri at Marlowe Chambers cannot advise on the planned setback enforcement until we can account for every recorded governing instrument, annexation and tract map across the two counties and the three developer names that were used. Prepare `recorded_governing_document_inventory.xlsx` as the controlled working inventory, research roadmap, schedule and budget we can authorize before records work begins. Ivo knows title work; Wilhelmina Kristiansen, who will maintain the file, does not, but this cannot become a title-research tutorial. Stonebridge Solutions is also moving from its shared-drive tracker into a matter system halfway through this work, so the workbook must remain usable during the transition and migrate cleanly afterward. Include a base forecast and a defensible high-cost case, but do not present assumed recording details as findings or offer a legal opinion. Keep the entire workbook to no more than six printed pages. Put the finished file in the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `recorded_governing_document_inventory.xlsx` — A controlled recorded-governing-document inventory, research roadmap, schedule and scenario budget for the six-phase property. (The workbook must be usable by counsel and a coordinator without title-research experience, support both the shared-drive transition period and later matter-system migration, distinguish assumptions from verified recording facts, include base and high-cost forecasts, and render in no more than six printed pages total.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

translation.literal_protection: Filenames, URLs, identifiers and Arabic-number tokens protected before translation and exact multiplicity verified. Materials, gold previews, original rubric objects and original audit records kept unchanged.
